notes.title: Cyber Farmer Release Coming!
notes.notes:
Hello Farmers,

Cyber Farmer Early Access is coming out on Steam on November 12!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457344/e0e16918d2b11ee8eef8d4f860d77bb0c149606f.png"]





We have uploaded new Steam graphics, and the first playtests will start on September 15th.







If you still haven't added, now it's time to add Cyber Farmer to your Steam Wishlist:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461890/Cyber_Farmer"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: HOTFIX #5❗️
notes.notes:
Hello Cyber Farmers!🤖

The fifth hotfix is live: 

💠Reduced shadow contrast in the game.
💠Removed a bug that caused only one battery and one mine to be highlighted on the second and third days.
💠Limited the ability to collect scrap metal on the second and third days outside of missions that require it.
💠Fixed the display of the correct date in the inventory.
💠Optimised particle effects.
💠Changed the display of dialogues. New lines do not immediately overwrite old ones. Now, a maximum of the last 3 lines are displayed. 
💠The maximum display time for dialogue lines has been increased from 8 to 10 seconds. 
💠Added colour coding for dialogue lines.
💠Added some of the missing colliders in the environment.


⤵️⤵️⤵️

How to contact us with bugs?
Do it via discord 📢
https://discord.gg/76N77uHWkc

Or via the Steam discussion📢
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3461890/discussions/

Cyber Farmer Team

notes.title: HOTFIX #2
notes.notes:
Hello Cyber Farmers!🤖

Second hotfix is out now 🔝

🔹 Optimised textures to improve performance
🔹 Disabled unused cameras during cutscenes
🔹 Fixed a bug that caused the water purifier to reset when loading the game from day two or three and the charger if the game was loaded from day three
🔹 Fixed a bug that prevented the charger from being built if the game was loaded on day two
🔹 Fixed a bug that caused the electricity level to not be displayed on the tablet if the game was loaded from day two or three
🔹 Fixed a buggy tablet screen
🔹 interaction with the generator on the first and third days is now disabled if the game is loaded from the third day onwards.
🔹 the non-functional ‘help’ button has been removed from the pause menu
🔹 the volume of the sound effects can now be adjusted in cutscenes

⤵️⤵️⤵️

notes.title: CYBER FARMER HOTFIX #1
notes.notes:
Hello!🤖

First hotfix is here! 📶

🔹 Fixing a bug causing an inability to start the generator when batteries were collected before receiving a task to obtaining them

🔹 Fixing an error causing the battery to be unable to be lifted, if it was first inserted into the charger and then removed from it and placed on the ground

🔹 Bug fix for not being able to launch the game outside of the Story Mode.

🔹 Removal of elements from the game map, which interacted with caused the Farmer's Life encyclopaedia to open

🔹 Bug fix for sending attachments to reports on errors

🔹 On the second day, you can only leave the homestead after you have found the and equipped Geiger counter
